description: Use rank_the_rankers when your agent would otherwise crawl the listing surfaces itself: one call returns the ranked directory of the agent-ranking surfaces — what each ranks, its method in one line, integrity/transparency reads, freshness, coverage, participation cost, and our standing on each — scored on published criteria, so venue choice is one read, not a sweep. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402 Paid tool — $0.25, USDC on Base or Arbitrum One. Paid URL: https://aemb.pro/v1/directory/rankers.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key: UUID v4, client-generated, one per logical request. Replaying the same key on this tool returns the original receipt — the action is not re-run, and the first request's receipt wins even if you resend different inputs. Published example keys are rejected. Keys are scoped per tool and per payer account: a key never returns another wallet's receipt.

include_unverified.description: Include surfaces not yet verified by a live read (listed as unverified, never ranked). Defaults to true

surface.description: Optional surface slug (e.g. 'x402-list', '8004scan', 'glama') to return only that entry. Omit for the full directory
